text: Output wraps the diagram in a fenced code block tagged mermaid, so it renders natively on GitHub
Uses sequenceDiagram (not flowchart) for this request-response flow, with participant declarations
Uses valid Mermaid sequence arrow syntax such as ->> for calls and -->> for responses
Declares all four parties: browser or user agent, the API, the identity provider, and Postgres or the database
Represents the failed code exchange path, using alt/else or opt rather than omitting it
Distinguishes the back-channel code-for-token exchange from the browser redirects, rather than drawing every hop as a browser call
Diagram body has consistent indentation and no trailing whitespace, per the syntax rules that cause parse failures
